channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa Nexus para presidente, após tensão entre Mendonça e Moraes
item.description: The upcoming Nexus/BTG poll for president will be released on September 8, following tensions between Supreme Court ministers André Mendonça and Alexandre de Moraes. The latest poll showed a tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round, with Lula leading over other candidates in tested scenarios.

item.title: Janja recebe DiCaprio em meio ao silêncio de Lula sobre Moraes
item.description: Janja Lula hosted Leonardo DiCaprio at the Planalto amid Lula's campaign silence regarding the STF Moraes controversy.

item.title: Renan Santos protocola pedido de impeachment contra Moraes e Toffoli
item.description: Renan Santos filed impeachment requests against Supreme Court justices Alexandre de Moraes and Dias Toffoli at the Federal Senate. The accusations follow revelations about the relationship between former banker Daniel Vorcaro and Supreme Court members, including million-dollar contracts and personal favors offered to Moraes. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will decide whether to archive or admit the requests.

item.title: TSE forma maioria para aprovar registros de candidatura de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e Romeu Zema
item.description: The TSE has formed a majority to approve the candidacy registrations of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema for the presidency, along with approving the Drap of their respective coalitions. The trial is taking place in the virtual plenary and awaits only the votes of ministers Estela Aranha and Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva. Other presidential candidates, such as Samara Martins and Edmilson Costa, also have majority favorable votes.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda Eduardo Bolsonaro apagar publicações que questionam as urnas
item.description: TSE minister Nunes Marques ordered Eduardo Bolsonaro to remove posts questioning the reliability of electronic voting machines and banned further publications of the same nature. The ruling responded to a request from the Brazil Hope Federation, citing risks to electoral security. Posts by other PL lawmakers were deemed protected under freedom of expression.

item.title: Augusto Cury comemora 3° lugar na Quaest e cobra Moraes: “Deve se explicar”
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) demanded investigation of Alexandre de Moraes over alleged messages with Daniel Vorcaro and stated there will be no immunity in government. He celebrated 10% poll numbers in Quaest survey, ranking third behind Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Vorcaro diz a Mendonça que quer delatar pessoas do ‘atual governo’ e citaria relação com chefe da PF
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro told Minister André Mendonça he wants to implicate members of Lula’s government and hinted at a link with PF chief Andrei Rodrigues, without providing evidence. His plea deal proposal was rejected for withholding information and lacking new proof.

item.title: MP denuncia Magno Malta por agressão contra funcionária de hospital
item.description: The Public Ministry filed a criminal complaint against Senator Magno Malta for assaulting a nurse during hospitalization at a private hospital in Brasília. The victim claimed the senator attacked her during preparation for a contrast exam. Malta denied the accusations and the court set a 10-day deadline for response.

item.title: Senado aprova incentivos para exploração de minerais críticos no Brasil
item.description: The Senate approved a bill creating a national policy for critical and strategic minerals, with incentives for domestic processing. The proposal includes a guarantee fund of R$2 billion and tax credits of R$5 billion between 2030 and 2034, aiming to add value to mineral exports and generate jobs.

item.title: Discussão sobre impeachment de Moraes é inevitável, diz Gaspar
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar stated that the impeachment of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is inevitable, but ruled out its approval in the current Senate under Davi Alcolumbre's leadership. He also criticized the STF session to analyze Moraes' investigation, calling it a source of institutional fragility.

item.title: Terras raras: Senado aprova projeto com fundo garantidor e crédito de R$ 5 bi para estimular exploração
item.description: The Brazilian Senate approved a bill establishing the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals (PNMCE), creating a guarantee fund and offering R$ 5 billion in tax credits to incentivize mineral processing in Brazil, including rare earths, with the bill now headed to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for promulgation.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Pesquisas mostram Flávio subindo e Lula estável na corrida eleitoral
item.description: Pollster Polli Data shows Flávio Bolsonaro rising in the 2026 presidential race while Lula holds steady. The electoral landscape signals shifting dynamics.

item.title: Gonet interferiu em eleição para conselho do Ministério Público, aponta relatório da PF
item.description: A Federal Police report reveals that Attorney General Paulo Gonet interfered in the election for the leadership of CNPG to benefit Jarbas Soares Júnior, brother of lawyer Ciro Soares, close to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Messages indicate Gonet convinced Georges Seigneur to withdraw, while Vorcaro celebrated the political interference. The case also involves contacts between Gonet and Vorcaro before a London event with Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Deputados governistas veem parcialidade de Mendonça e pedem derrubada de sigilo do caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Lawmakers allied with Lula requested the lifting of the secrecy of the investigation into the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', which addresses Jair Bolsonaro. The action was filed with the STF to deepen the analysis of the partiality perceived on the part of Justice Dias Toffoli. The case involves former banker Daniel Vorcaro and investigations into possible irregularities in cultural funding with political bias.

item.title: Visita ao Poder360: Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), visited Poder360 headquarters in Brasília and gave his first interview since being named vice-presidential candidate. He claimed that Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and President Lula are 'one and the same' and protect each other, also commenting on a potential Moraes impeachment and ongoing legal cases.

item.title: PL diz que Lula deve agir para não ser conivente no caso Vorcaro-Moraes
item.description: The PL urges Lula to take action regarding the Vorcaro-Moraes case to avoid being seen as complicit, following investigations involving billionaire contracts and interactions between the businessman and the STF minister. The party also demands the removal of the PF director and moves forward with a new impeachment request against Moraes.

item.title: 'Crise Master' no STF superou casos 'Dark Horse' e Lulinha em postagens nas redes sociais, aponta levantamento
item.description: The crisis involving STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro generated over 1.1 million social media posts in 24 hours, surpassing previous cases like 'Dark Horse' and 'Lulinha'. The peak occurred nine hours after message revelations, with 84,000 posts at that hour. Most posts on X were from right-wing profiles demanding action against Moraes, while the left questioned the case handling by André Mendonça.

item.title: Sem citar Moraes, presidente do PT diz que ‘sistema apodreceu’ e pede mudança no Judiciário
item.description: Edinho Silva, PT party president, criticized the judiciary and called for ethics reforms without directly naming Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who is under a PF report linking him to banker Daniel Vorcaro. The report reveals payments of $50 million to the office of Moraes’ wife and luxury service offerings.

item.title: PEC da 6×1 esbarra na escala eleitoral do Senado
item.description: The PEC eliminating the 6×1 schedule was approved at the Senate CCJ, but faces resistance for full chamber voting due to the election calendar. Government supporters seek to expedite the process, but the Senate president prefers normal procedures, coinciding with the electoral campaign period.

item.title: Tucanos se aproximam de Cury e o veem como alternativa de centro
item.description: PSDB leaders and candidates are approaching Augusto Cury (Avante), seen as a center alternative for those rejecting Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Cury's discourse aligns with traditional tucan positions in recent years.

item.title: “Se Moraes cometeu erros, deveria ter a dignidade para se autoexcluir”, diz Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, stated that Alexandre Moraes should have the dignity to recuse himself from the STF if ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro are proven. The statement follows a recent Supreme Court judicial decision.

item.title: Ibovespa tem forte avanço de mais de 3% de olho em pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The Ibovespa rose 3.05% to 185,200 points, driven by polling data showing Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied in a potential runoff. The emergence of a third track with Augusto Cury and expectations of more orthodox economic policy boosted investor confidence.

item.title: Deputados do PT e Psol pedem a Fachin fim do sigilo de caso “Dark Horse”
item.description: Lawmakers from PT and Psol requested STF president Fachin to lift the secrecy in the 'Dark Horse' case, which investigates alleged irregularities involving Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing that transparency is essential for the 2026 election.

item.title: Crise no STF pode respingar em Lula em meio a alertas da pesquisa Quaest divulgada nesta quarta
item.description: The STF crisis may impact Lula's image, particularly due to the proximity between the president and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who faces criticism from Bolsonaro supporters. A Quaest poll shows Lula leading the runoff with 42%, against 41% for Flávio Bolsonaro, narrowing the gap to one point. Lula's team sees lifting the secrecy of investigations into the funding of 'Dark Horse' as a strategy to balance the narrative.

item.title: Trump diz ter ‘boa relação’ com Brasil e sugere estar por trás do avanço da direita nas Américas
item.description: Donald Trump claimed the U.S. has a 'good relationship' with Brazil and attributed improving ties in Latin America to the rise of right-wing governments. He hinted at influence in regional elections and avoided mentioning President Lula, emphasizing alliances with conservative leaders.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Trump afirma ter ‘boa relação’ com o Brasil
item.description: Donald Trump stated he has a 'good relationship' with Brazil during a White House press conference, without referencing Lula. He emphasized improvements in ties with Latin America and claimed regional governments are shifting from left to right with his support.

item.title: STF em ponto de não retorno
item.description: The STF faces its greatest crisis after the Master case revealed a network of influence involving parliamentarians, Central Bank officials, and court members. Investigations into billion-dollar frauds expose a system of institutionalized corruption.

item.title: Campanha de Lula defende reforma do Judiciário: 'Ninguém está acima da lei'
item.description: Lula's campaign advocates for an urgent reform of the Brazilian political and judicial system, emphasizing that no one is above the law. Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, highlighted the need for systemic changes but did not specifically mention Supreme Court ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça. The stance reflects a critical institutional discourse without direct references to judicial figures.

item.title: Flávio defende Mendonça e diz que Moraes cometeu "diversos crimes"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended Supreme Court minister André Mendonça during a visit to Expointer, distinguishing his meeting with entrepreneur Daniel Vorcaro from suspicions involving Alexandre de Moraes, whom he accuses of committing several crimes.

item.title: CCJ do Senado dá nova vitória a Lula e aprova PEC da Segurança
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved the Public Security PEC, expanding federal authority and embedding the Single Public Security System in the Constitution. The measure advances to the Senate floor, marking a new political victory for President Lula's administration.

item.title: Número usado como contato de Moraes aparece ligado a contas digitais no TikTok e aplicativos de celular
item.description: A phone number linked to Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes was found associated with digital accounts on TikTok and mobile apps, according to a Federal Police report extracted from the phone of former Banco Master executive Daniel Vorcaro. The document suggests possible interactions between Vorcaro and Moraes regarding Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates alleged billion-dollar frauds at Banco Master.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que sistema político e judicial no Brasil "apodreceu"
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, stated that the Brazilian political and judicial system has 'rotted,' criticizing the crisis at the STF involving messages between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and banker Daniel Vorcaro. He advocates for reforms such as a judicial ethics code, an end to excessive salaries, and greater transparency, supporting President Lula da Silva's bid for reelection.

item.title: Após seis meses engavetada, texto-base da PEC da Segurança é aprovada na CCJ do Senado
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee symbolically approved the Public Security PEC, which establishes the Single Public Security System and advances the creation of the Ministry of Public Security, a Lula government priority. The text moves to the Senate plenary without a set date, while the focus remains on other PECs like the 6x1 scale reform.

item.title: Trump destaca “bom relacionamento” com o Brasil
item.description: Donald Trump emphasized the strong relationship between the United States and Brazil, claiming he helped elect candidates in South America, with a rightward political shift. He did not specifically mention Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Na Expointer, Flávio Bolsonaro se reúne com agronegócio do Rio Grande do Sul
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, met with Rio Grande do Sul agribusiness leaders at Expointer, an agricultural fair in Porto Alegre. The meeting took place at a restaurant in the Assis Brasil Exhibition Park.

item.title: Caiado, sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no caso Master: Não dá pra passar pano
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro over new payments from the Master Bank, stating that one cannot 'turn a blind eye' to the case. The episode reinforces debates on corruption and private interests in politics.

item.title: TSE manda Eduardo Bolsonaro excluir conteúdos falsos sobre urnas
item.description: The TSE ordered Eduardo Bolsonaro to remove YouTube content questioning the security of electronic voting machines, deeming it false. The decision was made by Minister Nunes Marques, president of the court.

item.title: TSE chama deepfake de deepfake, mas cria exceção e poupa Flávio
item.description: The TSE defines deepfake as fraudulent content, but creates an exception by not punishing Senator Flávio Doutorio for image editing in campaign. The decision generates controversy over selective application of electoral rules.

item.title: 6x1: oposição pede vista e presidente da CCJ dá 1h para análise
item.description: The president of the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee, Otto Alencar, granted one hour of review time for the PEC reducing the workday from 44 to 40 hours, following pressure from the opposition led by Rogério Marinho. During the session, rapporteur Omar Aziz defended the proposal's admissibility and rejected 35 amendments, while debates arose over deadlines and legislative priorities. The vote is scheduled for Wednesday, amid labor issues as a government priority for Lula.

item.title: Caso de Bolsonaro faz TSE fixar critérios para deepfake; entenda
item.description: The TSE established criteria to identify deepfakes in the 2026 elections while ruling on a lawsuit against Flávio Bolsonaro for using an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro. By 5-2, it defined deepfake as AI-synthesized content with high realism, but sanctions require classification as electoral propaganda. The court rejected fines against Flávio and ruled that displaying a video at an online party convention does not automatically constitute early campaigning.

item.title: As duas ‘batatas quentes’ que colocam André Mendonça no centro da eleição
item.description: The investigations involving INSS and Banco Master bring Justice Minister André Mendonça to the center of political tensions. His judicial decisions may influence key figures such as Fábio Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro, increasing electoral polarization. Additionally, public information related to Minister Alexandre de Moraes creates internal tensions within the STF.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: relator lê parecer; presidente da CCJ concede vista de uma hora após pedido da oposição
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Commission approved the report ending the 6x1 work schedule, granting one hour of review time by President Otto Alencar following opposition pressure. The constitutional amendment sets a reduction from 44 to 40 weekly working hours within 14 months, preserving two rest days, but introduces no major amendments to the version approved by the Chamber.

item.title: PEC do fim da 6 x 1: senador Rogério Marinho, coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro, pede vista
item.description: During the discussion at the Senate Committee on Constitution and Justice (CCJ) regarding the Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) that seeks to end the 6x1 scale, Senator Rogério Marinho, campaign manager for Flávio Bolsonaro, requested 'vista' on the project. This request aims to delay the PEC's progress and prevent the issue from reaching the Senate floor, representing a strategy used by the opposition to block or slow down the proposal's passage.

item.title: "Não é possível passar pano", diz Caiado sobre Flávio e Moraes
item.description: Caiado criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro and Moraes for not clarifying the controversy involving money from the Dark Horse film and conversations with Daniel Vorcaro, stating the situation cannot be treated as a blank page and requesting the immediate removal of Moraes from the STF due to alleged complicity.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Lula perde força e eleição de 2026 fica mais aberta
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Lula's approval dropping to 45% with 48% disapproval, pointing to a more open 2026 race. The president faces adverse media coverage and family scandals, yet still holds a slight edge over Flávio Bolsonaro in rejection ratings (55% to 53%). Supreme Court crisis and weak economic performance also weigh negatively on the incumbent.

item.title: Relatório Vorcaro-Moraes sai 2ª ou 3ª, e Fachin fará sessão semana que vem
item.description: The report by Minister André Mendonça regarding the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case is expected to be delivered on Tuesday or Wednesday, with a Supreme Court plenary session scheduled for next week, including live broadcast for transparency. The Court is divided between ministers supporting and opposing the investigation, with Carmen Lúcia as the deciding vote in case of a tie. The vote takes place amid pressure from right-wing protests on Independence Day.

item.title: Ao vivo: STF julga tributação de reservas das seguradoras
item.description: The STF resumes plenary sessions, reviewing the constitutionality of PIS/Cofins taxation on insurance companies' technical reserves. The session also marks the first participation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes following the disclosure of messages exchanged with Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro, within the scope of PF investigations.

item.title: Campanhas coordenadas de desinformação ameaçam as eleições
item.description: Coordinated disinformation campaigns use techniques like 'firehosing' and 'bot farms' to manipulate public opinion in the 2026 elections, without an adequate response from the Electoral Justice. Brazil has become a disinformation laboratory since 2018, with attacks on institutions and the political system. The intensification of the fight against disinformation by the STF and Minister Alexandre de Moraes has faced these actions, but the threat persists.

item.title: Nunes Marques mantém peça de campanha de Lula que associa Flávio Bolsonaro ao Master
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques rejected Flávio Bolsonaro's request to suspend Lula's campaign ad linking him to the Master scandal, deeming it legitimate political criticism. The ad uses edited clips of the senator, but Nunes Marques found no grave manipulation or factual falsehood. He also dismissed a PT lawsuit against the dissemination of Jair Bolsonaro's 'Letter to Brazilians,' ruling it was not early electoral propaganda.

item.title: STF está dividido e Carmen Lúcia será voto de minerva sobre Moraes
item.description: The STF is split over the investigation of Moraes in the Master case, with 4 justices in favor and 3 against. Carmen Lúcia holds the deciding vote, potentially breaking a tie. A session is scheduled next week amid pressure from right-wing demonstrations on September 2nd.
